## Create and sell Studio plugins

You can create and sell Studio [[external/roblox-creator-docs/studio/plugins|plugins]] to the creator community through the [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/creator-store|Creator Store]]. A plugin is an extension that adds additional features or functionality to [[external/roblox-creator-docs/studio/index|Roblox Studio]] and helps improve creator workflows. You can either offer plugins for free or sell them for a minimum of $4.99 USD. Roblox offers a market-leading revenue share for these sales, as only taxes and payment processing fees are deducted. For more information, see [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/creator-store#distribute-and-sell-assets|Creator Store - Distribute and sell assets]].

Creator assets promote collaboration and resource sharing, and help developers create better and more dynamic games.
